reason: The convergence flake's root cause is in the evidence store: stagedReplacementDate reads a replacement's time from SQLite's seconds-since-1970 REAL column, which does not round-trip a Date and lands one ulp after its publication instant about one time in four. The fix reads the exact time from the staged payload, as decodeStagedFile already does.
boundary_review: Only stagedReplacementDate changes; the publication-time invariant at EvidenceStore.swift:3266 is untouched. A deterministic test in ObjectConvergenceTests pins it. Acceptance, non-goals and dependencies are unchanged.
